negative_reviews.author: Malia Alderson
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately I am disappointed about my visit.
The biggest compliment goes to hard working staff, who managed to work fast, be kind and polite during a very busy evening period.
We were sat on a table that’s in between of everything. Every minute there were staff members or other customers walking around us. Tables are tiny and I had to put my handbag on the floor, as there wouldn’t be space for it on the table.
The ramen itself was underwhelming. Probably the most mid ramen I’ve ever had. It came lukewarm at best. Chashu pork should had been grilled for a longer time and had an unpleasant smell. It wasn’t bad, but there are so many better ramen shops in Soho.
It’s the first time in my life when I had a starter, ramen and a drink and I didn’t leave feeling very full.
Prices are good, and bubble tea was tasty (but it’s a small glass with a lot of ice in it).
The last disappointment was music - we expected Japanese music, but instead they play American and English pop.

negative_reviews.author: Hilarie Minhoue
negative_reviews.text:
The food was a mixed bag, but the vibe and drinks saved the night. I'd definitely go back for those!
The Food: The prawn and salmon were unfortunately the driest I’ve ever had—you could tell they were deep-fried and a bit too heavily salted.

issues: The GM/HC meeting recorded £42K in sales, while the Admin Meeting reported £44K at 24.5% wage, overcoming high Monday labour and an extractor fan issue (GM/HC meeting 17/11 and Admin Meeting 16/11).
Successes: Deliveroo prep time down, more covers than the week before, no inaccurate orders, lower food cost and only one 1 star review.
Labour is the main area to improve, especially on quieter shifts before closing, along with FOH and BOH deep cleaning.
Spend per head dropped despite the upselling trial (Admin Meeting 16/11).
Reviews: 49 five star, four 4 star, two 3 star and one 1 star (about food quality); food is now tasted morning, afternoon and evening, and FOH asks every table for a review.
BOH focus: speed, quality and broth checks, and better communication with FOH managers on stock levels.
Hygiene checks were 100% for the bar, bathrooms and BOH, and waste was recorded.
The Soho conversion was discussed: closing date 24/11, fit out from 30/11 for three weeks, targeting £70K a week (Admin Meeting 16/11).
Marketing budget was moved towards Soho (Weekly DPM meeting 17/11).
